options: A. To pressure the buyer into purchasing the highest-priced item in stock regardless of whether it fits their situation.
B. To memorize a rigid script so you can talk continuously without letting the customer raise objections.
C. To understand the customer's actual needs and budget so you can honestly recommend a product or service that provides genuine value and builds long-term trust.
D. To exaggerate product performance claims during the pitch and clarify limitations only after payment is completed.
